verdict.text: Creating a public connection is straightforward in the Developer portal, but submitting the connection for review is required before the authorization URL populates.
verdict.label: Inferred
verdict.note: Based on the public connection auth flow documentation stating the authorization URL field populates after submission for review.

hands_on_time.label: Inferred
hands_on_time.note: Estimated time required to fill out connection details, set redirect URIs, and retrieve client credentials in the Developer portal.

waiting_time.label: Uncertain
waiting_time.note: The documentation mentions submitting the connection for review, but does not provide approval timelines or review duration.

prerequisites.text: A Notion account with Workspace Owner permissions in the workspace where the connection is managed.
prerequisites.label: Sourced
prerequisites.quote: You are required to be a workspace owner to create a connection.

setup_steps.text: Navigate to the Notion Developer portal at https://app.notion.com/developers/connections.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Navigate to the Developer portal and create a new public connection.

setup_steps.text: Start creating a new public connection and set the installation scope to either 'Any workspace' or 'Selected workspaces only' (this cannot be changed after creation).
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: This can’t be changed after creation.

setup_steps.text: Under the OAuth configuration section, enter your redirect URI(s). If integrating via Composio, provide your Composio callback URI.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Fill out the form with your connection details, including your redirect URI(s) under the OAuth configuration section and the connection’s installation scope

setup_steps.text: Optionally, enter a Notion page URL in the 'Notion URL for optional template' input if you want users to duplicate a template page during authorization.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: add the URL of the Notion page you selected to the Notion URL for optional template input.

setup_steps.text: Submit the public connection for review to populate the Authorization URL field.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: The Authorization URL field populates after a public connection is submitted for review

setup_steps.text: Open the Configuration tab, copy your Client ID and Client Secret, and store them securely or input them into Composio.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: access the connection’s secrets in the Configuration tab. Similarly to the internal connections, these values should be protected and should never be included in

scopes.text: Standard public OAuth connections do not use a scope parameter in the authorization URL; permissions are granted dynamically when the user selects pages to share via Notion's page picker.
scopes.label: Inferred
scopes.note: Notion's public connection authorization URL specification lists only client_id, redirect_uri, response_type, owner, and state, with access governed by the user's selected pages.

scopes.text: Admin API connections use resource and capability pairs (such as workspace:read or workflows:write) to govern access for organization bot tokens.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: When you create an organization bot token, you assign scopes that control which resources the token can access and which actions it can take.

scopes.text: The user and permission-group Admin API scopes require an eligible Enterprise organization plan.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: The user and permission-group scopes are available only to eligible Enterprise organizations. If these scopes don’t appear in the organization console, contact your Notion representative.

limits_before_approval.text: The Authorization URL field is only populated after the public connection is submitted for review.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: The Authorization URL field populates after a public connection is submitted for review

limits_before_approval.text: Users can only share pages and databases with the connection if they have full access to those resources.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: The page picker only displays pages or databases to which a user has full access, because a user needs full access to a resource

approval_process.text: The public connection configuration must be submitted for review before the public authorization URL becomes available.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: The Authorization URL field populates after a public connection is submitted for review

approval_process.text: Marketplace listing details such as descriptions, categories, and images are managed separately through the Listings section.
approval_process.label: Inferred
approval_process.note: Documentation distinguishes technical OAuth public connection setup from public Marketplace listing management.

likely_blockers.text: Only workspace owners have permission to create connections in the Developer portal.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: You are required to be a workspace owner to create a connection.

likely_blockers.text: The connection's installation scope ('Any workspace' vs 'Selected workspaces only') is fixed at creation time and cannot be changed later.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: This can’t be changed after creation.

likely_blockers.text: End users cannot share pages or databases with the connection if they lack full access permissions to those resources.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: The page picker only displays pages or databases to which a user has full access, because a user needs full access to a resource

likely_blockers.text: Enterprise-specific Admin API scopes cannot be used without an eligible Enterprise plan.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: The user and permission-group scopes are available only to eligible Enterprise organizations. If these scopes don’t appear in the organization console, contact your Notion representative.

agent_can_do: Explain Notion OAuth parameters, redirect requirements, and token exchange requests.
Format client credentials and redirect callback URIs for your integration configuration.
you_must_do: Sign in to the Notion Developer portal as a Workspace Owner.
Fill in the public connection details and submit the application for review.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret and store them in your secure environment or Composio.

open_questions.text: How long does the review process take after submitting a public connection?
open_questions.label: Uncertain
open_questions.note: The documentation mentions that the authorization URL populates upon review submission, but does not provide review duration or criteria.

open_questions.text: Can a public connection be tested by external users before the review process is approved?
open_questions.label: Uncertain
open_questions.note: The docs explain how the authorization URL generates upon submission, but do not specify whether development/sandbox test modes exist prior to review.
